artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the red stand-up menu is nonsensical and malformed. Characters are fused, distorted, and lack consistent baseline alignment, typical of AI generation failing to render coherent typography.

The sushi rolls exhibit a 'waxy' or melted texture. The individual ingredients (rice, fish, cucumber) blend into each other without sharp boundaries, lacking the distinct granular texture of real rice.

The rim of the glass is uneven and slightly warped, not forming a perfect ellipse as expected from perspective projection. The reflection on the liquid surface is also inconsistent with the lighting direction.
While likely depth-of-field blur, the transition between the text lines and the paper background is overly soft, resembling smearing rather than optical defocus.
